Synopsis:
Eskom, South Africa's state-owned power utility, reported a second consecutive annual profit of R30.3bn ($1.88bn) for FY ending March 2026 — more than doubling the prior year's R14.0bn. The improvement is driven by higher tariffs, cost discipline, and operational recovery. Power outages fell sharply to just 4 days in the year vs. 13 days prior and a peak of 329 days in 2024.
